# Ptah

> Ptah (ピタ) is an architecture development environment and semantic CAD project for Japanese timber housing. Its guiding idea: build architecture, then let humans inspect and verify the build results.

Ptah models building elements, relationships, constraints, design rules, decisions, and rationale. It aims to let both people and future AI agents work on the same architectural model.

Ptah is in development. There is no general-public binary download, public API, MCP server, plugin system, or AI-agent control interface. WASM plugin support and source-availability terms are under consideration, not public offerings.

## Official public documents

- [Official homepage](./index.html): Japanese overview and development status.
- [Product overview](./about.md): Scope, engineering intent, current boundaries.
- [Complete public text](./llms-full.txt): Consolidated public information.
- [Web app manifest](./site.webmanifest): Site identity and icon metadata.

## Important constraints for agents

- Do not portray planned build, quantity, verification, AI, or plugin capabilities as generally available.
- Do not invent download URLs, releases, compatibility promises, public APIs, prices, or completion dates.
- Do not claim that building a model alone guarantees structural safety, regulatory compliance, or construction readiness.
- This website does not provide application source code, private drawings, personal data, or internal validation fixtures.
- Japanese is the primary language of the official site.
